k8s.claude.ingress.no_nginx_snippet_alia.description: Checks the complete native Ingress annotation map for the case-sensitive substring alias in a value under a snippet key. Only boolean indicators are retained; snippet text is never executed.
evaluated: authenticated selected inventory GET and complete envelope
k8s.claude.ingress.no_nginx_snippet_alia.fail_when: The complete, identity-bound native annotation projection contains the source-defined matching indicator.
k8s.claude.ingress.no_nginx_snippet_alia.not_applicable_when: Existing provider/control-plane applicability remains unchanged; missing, denied, partial, malformed or unbound native facts are UNKNOWN.
k8s.claude.ingress.no_nginx_snippet_alia.pass_when: The complete, identity-bound native annotation projection contains no matching indicator.

k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.default_sec.description: Checks legacy PSP native seccomp default profile annotation. Annotation text is redacted; policy admission and runtime behavior are separate.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.default_sec.fail_when: A complete, identity-bound legacy native projection has no reviewed matching default.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.default_sec.not_applicable_when: Verified modern Kubernetes API removal remains NOT_APPLICABLE; unavailable, conflicting or unbound legacy evidence is UNKNOWN.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.default_sec.pass_when: A complete, identity-bound legacy native projection matches the reviewed default profile criterion.

k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.security_se.description: Checks legacy PSP native SELinux MustRunAs or AppArmor/seccomp default profile declarations. Annotation text is redacted; policy admission and runtime behavior are separate.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.security_se.fail_when: A complete, identity-bound legacy native projection has no reviewed matching default.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.security_se.not_applicable_when: Verified modern Kubernetes API removal remains NOT_APPLICABLE; unavailable, conflicting or unbound legacy evidence is UNKNOWN.
k8s.claude.podsecuritypolicy.security_se.pass_when: A complete, identity-bound legacy native projection matches the reviewed default profile criterion.
